summary: Tests-only red-phase run for issue #39. Wrote the solver parity corpus harness (SolverParityCorpusTests: corpus schema, tie/exclusion/weight assertions, hand-computed green self-checks, red committed-corpus presence test), the PaletteAPIClient wire-contract pins that the generated-OpenAPI-client migration must keep green (PaletteAPIClientContractTests), and structural migration preconditions (OpenAPIClientMigrationTests: manifest deps + committed openapi.yaml), plus docs/ LID documentation for corpus consumption, the generated-client contract, and this verification plan. No Swift toolchain exists in this container ('swift' not found; bin/lint self-skips its Swift gate), so swift test could not be executed here: expected red results are established by test design and static review, not execution. Implementation (swift-openapi-generator wiring, spec commit, corpus commit from viamin/color_matching #110/#111) lands in the follow-up implementation run.
